gold.title: datetime.utcnow() is deprecated on the project's required Python (>=3.12)
gold.description: The official datetime docs mark utcnow() deprecated since 3.12 and recommend datetime.now(timezone.utc); pyproject.toml requires >=3.12, so every supported interpreter warns. The returned value is also naive, so age_seconds() against an aware `now` raises TypeError. Label matches on class, file, and line only — the fetched passage varies with the live page.

candidate.title: `datetime.utcnow()` is deprecated in every Python version this project allows
candidate.description: `utcnow()` returns naive datetime (no tzinfo), treated as local time by many methods. Project requires Python >=3.12 where this is deprecated (removed in 3.14). Fix: use `datetime.now(UTC)` instead.
